the most important factors for IT professionals to consider while planning for alternative employment are work conditions followed by compensation and family circumstances.
the work conditions, compensation and family circumstances have emerged as the most important factors that may influence the IT professional while deciding a job change.

the work conditions, compensation and family circumstances have emerged as the major alternative employment factors for IT professionals in India, while the family friendly policies, identification, recognition and motivation of the key performers and flexible working hours have emerged as the key retention strategies for IT professionals in the country.

the factors influencing the employees’ decision to quit their current job, and the factors that make them stay in their current job, in the context of Indian IT industry.
the identification of the factors that influence the decision to quit the current job and the factors which influence the decision to stay with the current job.
identifying factors that may be used by the IT companies to retain their key performers.

the IT professionals are more concerned about the work conditions and the compensation package than the other factors.

the retention strategies should not be limited to the monetary aspects alone but should be extended to the non-monetary aspects as well.
